description: Here are some of the best business printers available in India. The listed models from brands like HP, Brother, and Canon are suitable for office use in India. Buyers can compare their print quality, paper handling and running costs before making the purchase. They offer different print speeds and connectivity options. Some models are monochrome printers and offer printing, scanning, and photocopying features.
title: Best Business Printers in India for Office Printing

description: The iPhone 17e, OnePlus 15R, and iQOO 15R compete in the premium mid-range segment with powerful chipsets and AMOLED displays. The iPhone 17e runs on Apple’s A19 chip and iOS 26, while the OnePlus 15R and iQOO 15R use the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset. OnePlus offers a 165Hz AMOLED display and a 7,400mAh battery with 80W charging, while iQOO features a 7,600mAh battery with 100W charging. The iPhone focuses on ecosystem features, while the Android rivals emphasise display performance and faster charging.
title: iPhone 17e vs OnePlus 15R vs iQOO 15R: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Poco X8 Pro series will be launched in select global markets on March 17, according to a report citing industry sources. This comes soon after the company confirmed that its upcoming Poco X series, expected to be called the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max, will be equipped with the MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra and Dimensity 9500s chipsets, respectively. In the past, the phones have also been spotted on Xiaomi's website in Europe. The Poco X8 lineup is confirmed to be launched in India soon.
title: Poco X8 Pro Series Global Launch Date Leaked Ahead of Anticipated Debut: Expected Price, Specifications

description: A San Francisco-based startup is making some serious claims about its yet-to-be-launched audio jamming device. Dubbed Deveillance, the company is said to have developed a portable table-top anti-surveillance device called Spectre I, which can stop nearby microphones from recording audio. The startup claims that it achieves this by using power-efficient omnidirectional signals that are inaudible but can distort the audio recorded by devices within its range.
title: This AI-Powered Portable Device Claims to Detect Microphones and Jam Audio Recordings

description: Vivo appears to have showcased another X300-series smartphone at MWC 2026, which leaks suggest could be the rumoured Vivo X300 Max. The handset was seen during a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 presentation and was identified by a journalist, who shared images showing the model number V2548A. Photos indicate a Zeiss-branded rear camera layout with three visible sensors. The phone has also surfaced on China’s 3C certification database with support for 90W wired charging and is expected to feature a 6.78-inch LTPO OLED display and a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Vivo X300 Max With Zeiss Cameras and Android 16 Spotted at MWC 2026, Could Launch Soon

description: WhatsApp has released a new update for its iPhone users. WhatsApp for iOS (version 26.8.76) is the latest version and it includes a feature that suggests stickers while users type messages. This functionality shows related stickers whenever an emoji is entered in the chat bar. It is currently available to a limited number of users, and WhatsApp confirmed that more users will get the feature in the coming days.
title: WhatsApp Update Introduces Support for Discovering Stickers While Typing Emoji: How It Works

description: Dear Radhi follows Madhan’s paid date with Radhi that spirals into a thrilling chase revealing shocking secrets from her hidden life.
title: Dear Radhi OTT Release: Where to Watch the Tamil Thriller Online?

description: Kaattaan starring Vijay Sethupathi will stream on JioHotstar from March 27, 2026.
title: Kaattaan OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch Vijay Sethupathi Starrer Online?

description: Apple launched the MacBook Neo as its first-ever low-cost laptop on March 4. While it is currently available for pre-order with sales beginning March 11 globally, the MacBook Neo has appeared on a benchmarking site, offering a closer look at its performance before customers can get their hands on it. The new laptop is powered by the same A18 Pro chip as the iPhone 16 Pro, and the benchmark scores suggest similar performance levels as Apple’s flagship phone from 2024.
title: MacBook Neo Geekbench Scores Indicate It Performs on Par With iPhone 16 Pro Max

description: OnePlus 15T is confirmed to feature a 6.32-inch flat display. The display has rounded corners and slim bezels on all four sides. It is confirmed to feature an upgraded 3D ultrasonic fingerprint sensor and support magnetic accessories. Separately, the OnePlus 15T was spotted on Geekbench with model number OnePlus PLZ110. It was spotted with Android 16 and 16GB RAM. The OnePlus 15T is already confirmed to ship with a 7,500mAh battery.
title: OnePlus 15T Display Size, Ultrasonic Fingerprint Sensor Confirmed; Geekbench Listing Hints at Chip, Memory

description: With Love is a Tamil romance drama film which has been written and directed by Madhan. The film is now streaming on Netflix.
title: With Love Now Streaming on Netflix: Know Everything About Plot, Cast, and More

description: Xiaomi, on Friday, announced a new artificial intelligence (AI) agent, dubbed miclaw, for its smartphones and smart home devices. The agentic AI assistant has now entered a limited closed beta phase, and the company is now testing how the agent performs in real-world scenarios. The Chinese tech giant said that the tool is designed to function as a device-wide assistant that can autonomously complete tasks across third-party apps and system features.
title: Xiaomi Testing Experimental AI Agent Miclaw, Can Perform Complex Tasks Across Devices

description: Google’s Pixel 10a is nearly identical to the Pixel 9a it replaces. There are minuscule design changes as well. With faster charging being the only real-world improvement over the previous model, can the humble Pixel 10a stand up to the brutal competition at the lower-end of the premium segment in India?
title: Google Pixel 10a Review: More of the Same?

description: Google Pixel 10a is now available for purchase in India via Flipkart. The handset was launched in the country and other global markets on February 18 as the entry-level addition to its flagship Pixel 10 series. The new Pixel 10a is offered in a single 8GB+256GB RAM and storage configuration and in Berry, Fog, Lavender, and Obsidian colour options. It packs a 5,100mAh battery and features the same Tensor G4 chipset, which powers last year’s Pixel 9a. The new smartphone also ships with an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.
title: Google Pixel 10a With 5,100mAh Battery, 48-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Google has started warning users about Android apps that consume excessive battery due to high background activity. The Google Play Store will now display warning labels on apps that cause excessive battery drain. The apps which repeatedly cross the "Excessive Partial Wake Lock" threshold will be excluded from Play Store recommendations. Affected apps misuse Android’s partial wake lock mechanism and keep the CPU running in the background.
title: Google Play Store Starts Warning Users About Android Apps That Cause Excessive Battery Drain

description: Meta, on Wednesday, changed its policy to allow third-party artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots on WhatsApp in select regions. The updated policy was specified following objections from the European Union (EU), which found the older policy in breach of its competition rules. However, while the social media giant has agreed to open WhatsApp to rival AI platforms, it plans to charge them a fee for each non-template message sent.
title: Meta to Introduce Paid Third-Party AI Chatbot Integrations on WhatsApp After EU Intervention

description: Microsoft has finally taken the wraps off its plans for its next-generation gaming aspirations. The Redmond-based tech giant on Thursday announced that its upcoming Xbox console is codenamed "Project Helix." It is expected to succeed the current generation of Xbox systems. Microsoft claims the standout feature of the upcoming hardware is its ability to natively play both Xbox and PC games, potentially merging Microsoft’s two massive gaming ecosystems into a single hybrid device.
title: Microsoft Gaming CEO Asha Sharma Confirms ‘Project Helix’ Next-Gen Hybrid Xbox That Plays PC, Console Games

description: Motorola Razr 70 has appeared on the TENAA certification database, revealing key specifications of the upcoming foldable smartphone. The listing suggests it will feature a 6.9-inch OLED main display and a 3.63-inch cover screen, similar to the Razr 60. It is expected to be powered by a 2.75GHz octa-core chipset with up to 18GB RAM and up to 1TB storage. The phone may include dual 50-megapixel rear cameras and a 32-megapixel front camera. Battery capacity and dimensions appear largely unchanged from the previous generation.
title: Motorola Razr 70 TENAA Listing Reveals Key Specifications, Hints at Imminent Launch

description: New Webb observations refined asteroid 2024 YR4’s orbit, showing it will safely pass about 21,200 km from the Moon in December 2032. The earlier 4.3% impact probability has now been eliminated.
title: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope Confirms Asteroid 2024 YR4 Will Not Strike the Moon

description: Nothing recently refreshed its mid-range smartphone portfolio with the introduction of the Phone 4a series. The standard Phone 4a brings a significant shift to the design language. The most striking update is the introduction of the Glyph Bar, a departure from the segmented Glyph Interface found on the previous “a” series models. The Glyph Bar offers a simpler layout and updated interactions, while continuing the core idea of using LEDs on the rear panel for visual cues.
title: Nothing Phone 4a’s Glyph Bar Explained: A Simpler Take on Nothing's Glyph Interface

description: Oppo Find N6 will launch later this month. Now, Oppo announced that the Watch X3 will be launched alongside the new foldable smartphone. The company has posted a teaser video revealing the design of the wearable. Meanwhile, a well-known tipster shared alleged renders of the Oppo Find N6 on X. The renders show the phone in black, grey and orange colour options. The foldable is rumoured to come with a 6.62-inch outer display and an 8.12-inch external screen.
title: Oppo Find N6 IP Rating Confirmed as Leaked Renders Reveal Design; Oppo Watch X3 Teased Officially

description: The OTT platforms are ready to drop a fresh set of movies and web series releasing this week. Top releases include Subedaar, Young Sherlock, Gandhi Talks, etc.
title: OTT Releases This Week (Mar 2 - Mar 8): Gandhi Talks, Subedaar, War Machine, Young Sherlock, and More

description: Poco C85x 5G will be launched in India on March 10 as the latest addition to the Poco C series, the Chinese smartphone announced on Friday. On top of this, the Xiaomi sub-brand has updated the dedicated microsite for the handset to reveal its design. The phone appears with a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a pill-shaped camera module. The handset is shown to sport a dual-tone flat panel on the back. Moreover, it will be offered in at least a gold colour option. More details are expected to be revealed in the coming days.
title: Poco C85x 5G India Launch Date Announced, Design Revealed: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Poco X8 Pro Max has reportedly been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the Xiaomi 2602BPC18G model number. The handset appears with an octa core chipset. This comes soon after the Xiaomi sub-brand teased that one of the models in the upcoming Poco X8 series will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra SoC, while the second phone will be equipped with a MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset. The handsets are expected to be launched by the company later this month in India.
title: Poco X8 Pro Max Runs Geekbench as Company Reveals Chipset Details: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Realme C83 5G has been launched in India by the Chinese smartphone maker as the latest addition to its lineup. The handset is scheduled to go on sale in the country on March 7 at 12 pm IST via Flipkart and the Realme online store. It will be available for purchase in Blooming Purple and Sprouting Green colour options, and three RAM and storage configurations. It sports a 6.8-inch HD+ (720x1,570 pixels) LCD screen, offering up to 144Hz of refresh rate and up to 900 nits of peak brightness. The phone packs a 7,000mAh Titan Battery with support for 15W wired charging.
title: Realme C83 5G Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Truke TruClips open wireless stereo earbuds were launched in India at Rs. 1,999. The earbuds feature an open-ear clip-on design intended to allow ambient sound to remain audible during use. They come with 12mm customised titanium drivers and also include quad microphones with ENC, a 40ms low-latency mode, and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity with dual device pairing and touch controls. Truke claims up to 55 hours of total playback time with the charging case, which supports fast charging via a USB Type-C port.
title: Truke TruClips Launched in India With Open-Ear Design, Up to 55 Hours Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Vivo X300 Ultra was recently showcased at MWC 2026 in Barcelona. A company executive recently confirmed that the handset will feature a 200-megapixel primary camera, and has now shared more information about its upgraded periscope telephoto unit. It is claimed to adopt a gimbal-style stabilisation concept, achieving CIPA 7.0 professional-grade stabilisation. Apart from this, the Vivo X300 Ultra will also introduce a new focus tracking technology.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Confirmed to Feature Samsung HP0 Periscope Telephoto Camera With Professional-Grade Stabilisation

description: OpenAI released the GPT-5.4 artificial intelligence (AI) model on Thursday. The third major update to the GPT-5 foundational model arrives with improvements across parameters and new agentic capabilities, including computer-use. Unlike GPT-5.3-Codex, which was only released as a coding model for the Codex platform, the latest large language model (LLM) is being released for both ChatGPT and the application programming interface (API).
title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.4 AI Models With Agentic Computer-Use Capabilities

description: Samsung has reportedly increased the prices of several smartphones in India across its Galaxy M, F, and A series. The revisions are said to have taken effect on March 5. Updated prices are already reflected on Samsung’s official website. Models including the Galaxy M36, F36, M17 5G, F17 5G, A17 5G, and A06 5G have seen hikes of up to Rs. 3,000 depending on the variant. Samsung has not yet responded to Gadgets 360’s request for comment.
title: Samsung Galaxy Smartphone Prices Reportedly Hiked in India; Several Models Said to Be Affected

description: MacBook Pro (2026) was launched in India and other global markets by the Cupertino-based tech giant earlier this week, on March 3. The new laptop, which is currently available for pre-order in the country via the Apple India online store, is offered in 14-inch and 16-inch display sizes. It will also be available in Silver and Space Black colour options. Soon after its unveiling, Apple’s flagship 16-inch MacBook Pro (2026) with the new M5 Max chip has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform, hinting at its performance. The laptop is shown to outperform its predecessor with the M4 Max chip.
title: MacBook Pro (2026) With the M5 Max Chip Outpaces Older MacBook Pro Model With M4 Max on Geekbench

description: Chinese regulatory TENAA published a listing for an upcoming Honor phone. The handset listed with model number LNA-AN00 is believed to be the Honor X80i. As per the entry, it has a 6.6-inch OLED display with 1,200x2,600 pixels resolution. It is listed with an octa-core processor with a 2.6GHz CPU speed. It has a dual rear camera unit and a 6,800mAh battery.
title: Honor X80i Spotted on TENAA With 6,800mAh Battery, 6.6-Inch OLED Display

description: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion has debuted in India as a new mid-premium smartphone with a 6.78-inch 1.5K AMOLED display that supports a 144Hz refresh rate. The handset is powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset and comes with up to 12GB RAM and 256GB storage. It features a 50-megapixel Sony LYTIA 710 primary rear camera with OIS, a 13-megapixel ultra-wide lens, and a 32-megapixel selfie camera. The device packs a 7,000mAh battery with 68W charging and is priced from Rs. 26,999.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion Launched in India With 50-Megapixel Sony LYT-710 Camera, 7,000mAh Battery

description: The OnePlus 15T is expected to go official in China soon as the latest addition to the OnePlus family, which already comprises the OnePlus 15 and OnePlus 15R. While its launch date has yet to be announced, a tipster has shed light on what it could offer in the display department. It is tipped to feature a 1.5K resolution screen with support for a high refresh rate. Meanwhile, a company official has confirmed several details about the upcoming OnePlus 15T, too.
title: OnePlus 15T Tipped to Feature 1.5K 165Hz Display as Company Confirms Key Specifications

description: The Samsung Galaxy A37 5G and Galaxy A57 5G are expected to go official soon as the latest additions to the Galaxy A-series lineup. While the South Korean tech conglomerate has yet to confirm the handsets, their full specifications have been leaked. According to a report, both models will come with a 120Hz full HD+ AMOLED screen. The Samsung Galaxy A37 5G may be powered by the Exynos 1480 SoC, while the Galaxy A57 5G could run on a slightly more powerful processor.
title: Samsung Galaxy A37 5G and Galaxy A57 5G Specifications Reportedly Leaked in Full Ahead of Launch

description: The Phone 4a Pro is Nothing's official entry into a price segment that OnePlus once ruled in India. Here's what I feel about the device.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Pro First Impressions
